config.design: Frozen combined-local-write output PCA on old wording item0-3 only. Compare uncentered raw-row PCA, per-row unit-norm PCA, and one seeded orthonormal random basis at ranks1/4/8/16/32. Same item/wording splits as H613, plus locked4-head baseline. Coefficients are projections of observed per-position interaction write; no target-free predictor or global compression claim. Evaluate full local-write removal fidelity, not just target shrinkage.
config.scope: Adaptive on familiar panel; old discovery eight endpoints, old holdout eight, new wording sixteen. Per-row weighting prevents large native write norms from dominating but is not a causal objective. No rank or basis selection on evaluation.
